text.en:
On Weapon Kill for 7 seconds:
< weapon type ( Shotgun, Bow ) >
+20% Damage
< ( other ) >
+30% Damage
<$$>
-20% Rate of Fire/Charge Rate
< weapon type ( Bow, Heavy GL, GL ) >
// just to remove rage stat from weapons without range
< ( other ) >
+10 Range
<$$>

<title Hover for additional information. [damage] />
title damage (
Bows and Shotguns only receive +20% Damage.
Everithing else receives +30% Damage.

Bows and Grenade Launchers do not receive the +10 Range increase due to not having a Range stat. 
)

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased to 8 seconds.
)
